title: Known-failure memory
description: Past failures and their root causes. Append-only. MUST reference an Incident in the Evidence Model (docs/memory-model.md validation rules).

incident_ref.description: Required. References the evidence/Incident this entry was learned from — no known-failure entry without a backing incident.

regression_id.description: Set if this failure has recurred (references an evidence/Regression entity, post-MVP).
